newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi calls for immediate talks on lira ERM level.
newsitem.headline: Prodi calls for immediate talks on lira ERM level.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi on Friday called for "immediate, rapid" talks with other European countries over a level at which the lira could re-enter the European exchange rate mechanism (ERM).
The Italian premier said he did not talk about the issue with French President Jacques Chirac at their bi-lateral summit in Naples on Thursday and Friday.

"We didn't talk about it precisely because this has to be the subject of immediate, rapid, technical negotiations at a multilateral level," Prodi told a news conference at the end of the French-Italian summit in this southern Italian city.
Chirac, who has repeatedly attacked the devaluation of the lira over the past three years, told reporters he approved of recent lira gains.

The lira crashed out of the ERM during a currency crisis in September 1992. In the subsequent devaluation, it lost up to 40 percent of its value against the French franc but has since regained about 18 percent of this lost ground.
